fauna.evidence: Each taxon's extinction date in assets/earth/config/fauna-species.json: Tasmanian emu c. 1865, Steller's sea cow 1768, Chatham penguin after c. 1500, Falkland wolf 1876, Dusicyon avus to c. 400 BP in southern Patagonia, aurochs 1627, baiji 2006; the New Zealand, Chatham and Lord Howe birds outlived human arrival (New Zealand c. 1280). The others in that file died out before 1318 and need the extinct-animals option.
